A real-coefficient polynomial of even degree has the full n-1 upper zeros iff it has no real root. Strict interlacing and positive partial fraction residues prove equal-height nonemptiness, while equality at a closed-interval maximum gives a real multiple root. Completing the n=2 quadratic gives the exact hyperbolic-sine threshold. Ninety-six exact rational symbolic checks passed.
